name: qa-automation
description: Single-config QA automation pipeline for Playwright, Postman, JMeter, and GitHub Actions

scripts.test:api: postman collection run tests/api/postman/collection.json -e tests/api/postman/environment.json -r cli,json --reporter-json-export reports/postman/report.json
scripts.test:all:chain: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:api && npm run test:performance
